skill.name: similarweb-analytics
skill.description: Analyze websites and domains using SimilarWeb traffic data. Get traffic metrics, engagement stats, global rankings, traffic sources, and geographic distribution for comprehensive website research.
skill.userDescription: Analyze website traffic, user engagement, global rankings, traffic sources, and geographic distribution using Similarweb data.
exampleQuestions: Analyze the traffic sources and engagement metrics for github.com over the past month.
Compare the global rankings and monthly traffic of openai.com and anthropic.com.
What is the geographic distribution and audience breakdown for reddit.com?
